items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Well me and him play together with guitar and trumpet up and down Bollyfoot long time ago.

ctx.x: Well me and him play together with guitar and trumpet up and down Bollyfoot long time ago. It's guitar and trumpet. Lonnie Johnson. But we all call him Rooster at home. Well where is he from? He's from uh somewhere out from Memphis. Not on, not in Memphis.
